info.title: riskdep
info.summary: Risk of DeFi positions on Ethereum, centred on Morpho.
info.description:
HTTP API over `riskdep`, for the browser UI in `web/`.

Responsibilities, and only these: address the artifacts, validate the inputs, serve JSON.
No risk logic lives here — `pipeline.analyze` computes, `report.to_dict` and `graph.to_dict`
shape, this module routes. Adding a rule or a threshold here would be a mistake.

The watcher is deliberately **not** hosted: `python -m riskdep watch` runs as its own process
and appends to `out/watch-*.jsonl`; `GET /api/alerts` reads those files with a block cursor.
That keeps one poll loop per target however many browsers are open, and lets either side
restart without the other.

Run it with:  uv run uvicorn riskdep.api:app --reload

get.description:
The dependency graph. With no user and no vault, the last graph written to `out/`.

The whole graph is returned in one payload: selecting a node and walking its dependencies
is the client's job, not an endpoint — 100 nodes fit in the browser and Cytoscape traverses
them better than a round trip would.

get.description:
Alerts the watcher has recorded, after a block cursor.

Poll this: pass the previous `cursor` back as `since`. The cursor is a block number, the
same unit the watcher resumes from, so moving to a push transport later changes the
delivery and not the contract.
